integrity.claim_scope: All finite or countable triangle-free simple graphs for the rank-three criterion; six vertices for the exact labelled and unlabelled census.
integrity.computational_basis: Dependency-free checker exhausts all 32768 six-vertex graph masks and independently expands 14 rooted templates under all 720 relabellings.
integrity.proof_basis: Three-round rank recursion and triangle exclusion; forced six-vertex witnesses and 14 rooted templates.

scientific_limitations: The one-point-extension rank is relative to the hereditary age of triangle-free finite graphs, not to the unrestricted graph age.
Only rank thresholds one, two, and three are classified; no claim about rank four, higher ordinals, or the Rank Property is made.
The nine-class numerical census is an exhaustive finite result on six vertices; the general equivalence is supported by a separate all-order proof.
Historical priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit or external replication has been performed.
title: Rank-three witnesses and the nine six-vertex forbidden shapes for triangle-free graphs
